Usa a ferramenta nativa cleanmgr. Escolh: Uses the native cleanmgr tool. Choose categories (cleanmgr /sageset:64) opens the Windows window to mark what to clean and deletes nothing. Run (cleanmgr /sagerun:64) cleans the chosen categories. It reaches items the app does not clean, such as old update files.
